buildingHeightUnreviewed: Inferred · unreviewed. Using a height does not approve it. Review the source and property separately.
buildingHeightNoSections: No eligible section or elevation pages were found.
buildingHeightAlreadySet: This building already has a fire height. It will not be overwritten.
buildingHeightNoObservations: No supported height observations on this page.
buildingHeightCopied: Height copied as inferred and unreviewed. Property approval is a separate step.
buildingVolumeGroundReference: Translucent surface: assumed ground at level 0, not surveyed terrain. Negative levels sit below it.
buildingVolumeGroundUnknown: Ground reference unavailable: every floor needs a level index, including level 0. Page order does not establish basements.
buildingVolumePlacementDetails: Plans are centred, not registered. Floors use entered levels, otherwise plan order; spacing uses room heights plus an assumed 0.30 m floor allowance. Wall gaps stay open. These preview assumptions are not saved or used in calculations.
buildingVolumeWallReview: Wall footprint from the plan; height inherited from the storey. Review its outline, phase and exterior/interior role in 2D. The enclosure is not verified as complete.
buildingVolumeDisclaimer: Source wall footprints and translucent room drafts. Missing heights use 2.60 m. Preview only—not approved geometry, topology or compliance.
buildingVolumeNoGeometry: These rooms have no usable outline, or their matched room is already shown. Review the selected outline in 2D; label anchors are not room geometry.
buildingVolumeNoRooms: No rooms or room drafts on this source page and construction state. Select a floor-plan page or check extraction in Plan context.
buildingVolumeNoScale: Room outlines are available, but this page has no metric scale. Set the plan scale to show their volumes.
buildingVolumeDraftReview: Extracted outline—not approved geometry, construction phase or topology. Accepting it creates a canonical room; height assumptions still need separate confirmation.
buildingVolumeMatch: This draft may match an existing room. Review the match in 2D to avoid creating a duplicate.
buildingVolumeDraftHeight: This draft uses the storey height or the unsaved 2.60 m preview default. Accept its outline before saving a room override, or edit the storey default now.
buildingVolumeUnavailable: 3D is unavailable in this browser. Dimensions can still be edited here.
buildingVolumePrevious: Previously reviewed: {value} m. The new draft does not replace that review.
buildingVolumeSelectRoom: Select a room to edit its height.
buildingConnectionDisclaimer: Review geometric connections only. This does not approve fire resistance, sound insulation or escape routes.
buildingConnectionDeriveHint: Uses accepted room and wall outlines across the model. Also proposes wall roles, thicknesses, openings and ceilings. Keeps reviewed connections.
buildingConnectionDraft: Accept room and wall outlines in the 2D plan before deriving canonical connections. A preview outline is not a confirmed boundary.
buildingConnectionNoBoundaries: No active wall boundaries for this room. Enclosure is unresolved.
buildingConnectionMissingSide: Wall side {side} is unresolved. It is not assumed to face outside.
buildingConnectionAmbiguousHost: Several active wall hosts. The opening's host is ambiguous.
buildingConnectionMissingHost: No active wall host for this opening.
buildingConnectionEmpty: No stored connections. Select an object or derive from accepted outlines.
buildingConnectionAlignmentGap: Connections do not yet establish a closed shell or align floors. Floor placement remains schematic.
buildingCalculationHint: Calculate this page with all non-demolished accepted geometry and usable candidates, independently of the display filter. Nothing is accepted or approved.
buildingCalculationCounts: {used} candidates included · {excluded} excluded or already reviewed
buildingCalculationLimits: Conditional results, not compliance. Missing specifications stay missing; no height or material is invented. Exterior noise needs site and facade inputs. Whole-building and cross-storey checks remain separate.
buildingCalculationFire: Fire checks: {complete} evaluated · {open} blocked or unsupported. Evaluated does not mean compliant.
buildingCalculationSound: Interior sound: {count} wall calculations without input gaps.
